locationNews.headline: BRO Restores Sela Pass Convoy Traffic
locationNews.summary: Snow clearing dozers completed black ice clearance.

locationNews.headline: BRO Restores Sela Pass Convoy Traffic
locationNews.summary: Snow clearing dozers completed black ice clearance.

locationNews.headline: BRO Clears Black Ice on NH-13; Night Curfew Enforced From 17:00
locationNews.summary: Snow clearing dozers have restored one-way convoy traffic on Sela Pass. Anti-skid chains mandatory for 4x4 vehicles. Civilian traffic strictly halted post 17:00 IST.
locationNews.travelAdvice: Transit only in official morning convoys. Ensure adequate anti-freeze, thermal rations, and portable oxygen before leaving Dirang.

locationNews.headline: Flash Rain Warning: Wet Trail Alert for Double Decker Root Bridges
locationNews.summary: Sudden precipitation of 85mm recorded. Steps from Tyrna to Nongriat are extremely slippery. Forest department cautionary advisory active.
locationNews.travelAdvice: Do not attempt return trek after 16:00. Hire certified local Khasi village guides and carry trekking poles.

locationNews.headline: Speed Limit 40 km/h on NH-715 Wildlife Corridors Active via Sensor Cameras
locationNews.summary: Wildlife crossing activity observed between Kohora and Bagori ranges. Automated sensor speed interceptors and patrol squads active.
locationNews.travelAdvice: Maintain strict 40 km/h speed limit. Do not alight from tourist vehicles on the highway strip.

locationNews.headline: River Ferry & Brahmaputra Aerial Ropeway Running on Normal Schedule
locationNews.locationName: Guwahati Inland Waterway Terminal / Ropeway Ghat
locationNews.summary: River water levels stable at 48.2 meters. Passenger ro-pax vessels and aerial ropeway operational till 18:30 IST for Kamakhya-North Guwahati transit.
locationNews.travelAdvice: Carry SurakshaYatra Digital Tourist ID for express digital boarding pass scanning at ghat counters.

locationNews.headline: Sub-Zero Temperatures (-3°C) Overnight; Mandatory Check-in at Dzukou Rest House
locationNews.sourceAgency: Nagaland Tourism & Southern Angami Youth Organisation (SAYO)
locationNews.summary: Sudden frost front approaching alpine valley. Solo campers must register with SAYO guide desk at Viswema trailhead before ascending.
locationNews.travelAdvice: Trekking prohibited after 15:30. Carry high-altitude rated sleeping gear and satellite emergency beacons.

locationNews.headline: Shillong Peak Eco-Walk Open; One-Way Traffic Loop from Upper Shillong
locationNews.sourceAgency: East Khasi Hills Traffic Police & Meghalaya Tourism
locationNews.summary: Weekend tourist influx managed with smooth one-way loop. Parking capacity currently at 65%. Viewpoint security desk active.
locationNews.travelAdvice: Electronic toll payment via FASTag and SurakshaYatra Tourist ID QR accepted for express vehicle entry.

locationNews.headline: 5km Border Defense Corridor: Valid Inner Line Permit (ILP) Mandatory
locationNews.summary: Enhanced patrol checkpoints active along international boundary. Tourist movement permitted on designated cultural trail only with registered village guides.
locationNews.travelAdvice: Keep SurakshaYatra Digital ID and ILP QR code ready for quick scanning at defense gates.

locationNews.headline: Crystal Clear Water Conditions at Dawki; Boatman Safety Gear Mandatory
locationNews.locationName: Dawki Umngot River & Tamabil Border Point
locationNews.summary: Visibility depth exceeds 5 meters. All tourist boats equipped with life vests and emergency geo-tags.
locationNews.travelAdvice: Avoid crossing designated international maritime buoy line marked with orange flags.
